texts.zh:
最近间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到[from.target.GetName]上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。因此，他们的追求与忠诚背道而驰。

在间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]重整部门风气前，有关行动[from.GetName]的一切项目均被暂时搁置。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the [from.target.GetName], after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] discovered these operatives skimming from resources allocated to intelligence-gathering and bribes. These goods and currencies are being re-invested elsewhere in [from.target.GetAdj] business concerns, earning the operatives a comfortable profit at our expense. As a result, their attention and loyalties have clearly become divided.

Progress on Operation [from.GetName] has been put on hold for the moment, until Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] can re-assert operational efficiency.

间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]遗憾的报告：我们失去了[fromfrom.target.GetName]上的间谍网。

当我们特工中的一群小偷被要求解释原因时，他们的反应是逃跑——分散到[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的宇域里，那些甚至连我们都难以监控的地方。[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]不再能够追踪他们——至少没法在不引发注意的情况下找到。
texts.en:
Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] regretfully reports a breakdown in our [fromfrom.target.GetName] Spy Network.

When a group of thieves amongst our operatives was called to account, their response was to flee - scattering to parts of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] space that even we struggle to monitor. [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is no longer able to track them down - at least not without drawing undue attention.

summary.text:
# 资源耗尽 / Drain on Resources

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nemesis_operations_events_1.txt, common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt, common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

行动失手随机事件：间谍行动某一阶段的检定失败时，on_roll_failed 调用 standard_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed（common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt:2331-2386）：每次失败有 1/40 的几率（39:1）从该行动类型指定的事件池中抽一件，且同一行动 90 天内只触发一次。事件池按双方帝国类型（普通/集体意识）选择（:2390-2821）。
Mishap: when an operation stage roll fails, on_roll_failed calls standard_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed, which has a 1-in-40 chance to draw one event from the pool named by the operation type (at most one per 90 days per operation); pools are chosen by empire kinds.
本事件进入的事件池：
- 普通对普通（权重1，EF:2457）；低风险池。 regular -> regular.
Pools containing it:
regular -> regular.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

5040：间谍首脑发现手下人员在贪污资源。a 严厉申斥 → 5041“特工尽了本分”或 5042“特工断绝关系”；b 处理掉这些特工；c 利用这点作优势。
5040: operatives are skimming resources; reprimand (-> 5041 toe the line / 5042 cut ties), dispose of them, or exploit it.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 5041 与 5042 互斥。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 有犯罪类线人时的权重衰减不同（EF:2457-2475）。

- 已核对 Checked：5040-5042。
